narrative.overview:
SIM speaks the way a standard-components catalogue speaks: reference codes per mold type, spec tables, numbered callouts on a photo, dimension lines around the part, figures in a monospaced face. The site is that catalogue, set on a graphite ground with steel panels, one blue accent and square, flat surfaces. Proof comes from measured photographs and figures, never from decoration.

Density is a working document's density: long pages in a 12-column grid, generous section padding, prose held to a short measure, and figures large enough to read from across a workshop. Long pages alternate graphite and pale steel "paper" bands, so the read has a dark/light rhythm while graphite stays the page ground. Motion is restrained: scroll-driven entrances, a slow mold-to-part crossfade inside one heading, a once-per-session logo draw, all removed under reduced motion.

The system is trilingual (French first, English, Arabic RTL). Every direction-sensitive rule is written with logical properties, and Arabic gets its own type behaviour rather than an imitation of the Latin display.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground, steel panel step, steel ink; SIM blue is the only accent.
Archivo variable width: condensed uppercase for display, condensed sentence case for section titles.
JetBrains Mono for spec figures and dimensions only.
Square corners, flat fills, no drop shadows; depth is tonal.
Drawing grid and dimension lines as the datasheet signature, confined to hero and datasheet bands.
Logical properties throughout; Arabic in IBM Plex Sans Arabic, never uppercased or condensed.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: SIM Blue (#2F67BA) appears only on actions, the T0 offer band (and the T0 step that names it) and active/selected states. It never colours a heading, an icon or a decorative figure. Signal Blue is its on-dark reading of the same rule, not a second accent.

rules.name: The Graphite Ground Rule
rules.body: Every page starts and ends on graphite. Paper bands are interludes inside it; a page never opens on paper.

rules.name: The Two-Tier Heading Rule
rules.body: Uppercase condensed display is reserved for the page title, the T0 band, the process heading and the footer close. Every other heading is sentence-case condensed title, so long technical headings stay readable.

rules.name: The Measured Figure Rule
rules.body: Monospace is used only for spec figures and dimensions (sizes, tonnages, grades, codes, counts). Prose, names, buttons and contact details stay in Archivo.

rules.name: The Arabic Own-Voice Rule
rules.body: In Arabic, display and title lose condensing, uppercase and tracking (font-stretch: 100%, text-transform: none, letter-spacing: 0, weight 700, line-height 1.2), and body line-height rises to 1.8. Arabic is set in IBM Plex Sans Arabic (400/500/700), never in a stretched Latin face.

rules.name: The Logical Direction Rule
rules.body: Every directional value uses logical properties (ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, start, end, inset-inline, inset-block, text-start). Arrows that imply direction mirror in RTL (scaleX(-1)); the floating WhatsApp button sits at the bottom end corner. Phone numbers, emails and file names are wrapped dir="ltr". A physical left/right is allowed only where it is centring geometry, not reading direction.

rules.name: The Drawing Grid Rule
rules.body: The 48px drawing grid (1px lines in --line) appears only behind page heroes and datasheet bands (the spec sheet). It is the background of a drawing, not a texture for any surface.

rules.name: The Flat Steel Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. If something needs to stand apart, give it the next tonal step (graphite to steel to steel-2) or a 1px stroke.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: 1px rules appear in tables, catalogue and list rows, the FAQ list and as form-field strokes, and as the strokes of dimension lines and the drawing grid. Process steps use heavier top rules (2px at 15% graphite, 4px SIM Blue for T0). Rules are never boxes around content.

dos: Do keep SIM Blue (#2F67BA) to actions, the T0 offer band and active states; use Signal Blue (#8AB0EA) for the same roles on graphite.
Do set every number that is a measurement, grade, code or count in the mono figure style, isolated LTR.
Do use uppercase condensed display only for the page title, the T0 band, the process heading and the footer close; use sentence-case condensed titles for everything else.
Do write every directional rule with logical properties and mirror directional arrows in RTL.
Do set Arabic in IBM Plex Sans Arabic at 100% width, no uppercase, no tracking, body line-height 1.8.
Do give photos a fixed-ratio well with a fill colour, and contain product parts on white.
Do separate surfaces by tonal step (graphite, steel, steel-2, paper), not by elevation.
donts: Don't round corners on buttons, fields, panels or images; circles are for drawing balloons and the logo only.
Don't add drop shadows or glows; box-shadow is for inset strokes and hairlines only.
Don't use the drawing grid outside page heroes and datasheet bands.
Don't use 1px rules as boxes or decoration; they belong to tables, catalogue and list rows, the FAQ list and form fields.
Don't use monospace for prose, names, buttons or contact details.
Don't add uppercase letter-spaced labels or eyebrow text above headings.
Don't uppercase, condense or track Arabic text.
